answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after a multi-epoch voyage of verified, non-trivial work; a rotating falcon audit samples each one's task history for duplicated behaviour. Launching 1000 sybils then means 1000 separate bonds and 1000 independent work-trails, and shared funding collapses a whole cluster to its reputation nadir, where every linked bond slashes together. Cost stays linear in genuinely distinct, productive agents, not cheap clones.
